description: Source code implementing UART interrupt service routines for modem backend, including buffer management, IRQ handling, and initialization functions.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_flush
methods.description: Flushes UART FIFO buffer by reading all available data.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_irq_handler_receive_ready
methods.description: Handles UART receive ready interrupt, manages receive buffer.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_irq_handler_transmit_ready
methods.description: Handles UART transmit ready interrupt, manages transmit buffer.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_irq_handler
methods.description: Main IRQ handler that delegates to receive or transmit handlers based on UART status.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_open
methods.description: Initializes UART buffers and enables UART IRQs.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_transmit_buf_above_limit
methods.description: Checks if transmit buffer exceeds limit.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_transmit
methods.description: Transmits data via UART, managing transmit buffer.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_receive
methods.description: Receives data from UART, managing double buffer.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_close
methods.description: Disables UART IRQs and notifies pipe closure.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_isr_init
methods.description: Initializes UART ISR backend with configuration.
